figures.finding: The Netherlands Antilles no longer exists and levies no tax: it was dissolved on 10 October 2010, when Curaçao and Sint Maarten became countries with their own tax and Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba became special municipalities of the Netherlands; a person on those islands is taxed under the file for Curaçao (CW), Sint Maarten (SX) or the Caribbean Netherlands (BQ).
